- **Sentry is back to its old role.** I withdrew my earlier request and replaced it: Sentry doesn't delegate to Dev or route merges. It reports to me, as before. - **My routine does the handoff.** I changed it to "Sentry tickets: Dev handoff and merge" and it now runs hourly, around the clock, starting 16:00 UTC. Routine runs happen in our conversation, so the handoff isn't refused there, and Dev's ready result comes back to me. I also updated my saved rule to match.
